readingHtml:
The Future of Artificial Intelligence

How AI will change our lives
Tip: Watch the video to understand the basics of AI. Then read the text to practice your future tenses!

A. Artificial intelligence is no longer science fiction. It is already part of our daily lives. Tech companies are investing billions into new innovation. Next year, they are going to launch even smarter algorithms. We are going to see cars that drive themselves and computers that can write essays. This is a huge breakthrough for humanity.

B. However, this creates fear. Many people worry that automation will take their jobs. Will robots replace the human workforce? Experts say that while machines will do routine tasks, they will not replace human creativity. By 2050, the workplace will have changed completely. We will be working alongside robots, not against them.

C. There are also ethical questions. It is difficult to predict how AI will behave. If we give machines too much power, will they be dangerous? We must create strict rules. This time next year, governments will be debating new AI laws. By the time the decade ends, we will have established a global framework for AI safety.

D. Ultimately, humans are good at one thing: we can adapt. When new technology arrives, we learn how to use it. As soon as we understand AI better, we will use it to solve climate change and diseases. The future isn't something that happens to us; it is something we are going to build.

testTfng.q: We use 'will' to talk about fixed arrangements.
testTfng.exp: We use the Present Continuous for fixed arrangements.

testTfng.q: We use 'going to' for predictions based on evidence (e.g., dark clouds).
testTfng.exp: Yes, e.g., 'It is going to rain.'

testTfng.q: We use the Present Simple after 'when' and 'if' to talk about the future.
testTfng.exp: Correct, e.g., 'When I arrive, I will call you.'

testTfng.q: The Future Perfect describes an action in progress at a future time.
testTfng.exp: Future Perfect describes an action completed before a future time. Future Continuous describes actions in progress.

testTfng.q: 'I'm going to the cinema tonight' is an arrangement.
